description: This file defines the DateTimeResult class, an extension of PHP's DateTime class with additional methods for parsing timestamps in various formats (epoch, ISO8601), supporting nanosecond precision and serializing to JSON. It is used within the AWS SDK for PHP for handling date/time values with higher precision and seamless serialization.

classes.name: DateTimeResult
classes.description: An extended DateTime class that provides static methods for constructing instances from epoch or ISO8601 timestamps, supports nanosecond precision, and implements JSON serialization for AWS SDK date handling.

methods.name: fromEpoch
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeResult instance from a Unix timestamp, supporting fractional seconds and microsecond/nanosecond precision based on PHP version.

methods.name: fromISO8601
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeResult instance from an ISO8601 formatted timestamp, with support for nanosecond to microsecond precision.

methods.name: fromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeResult from a general timestamp, trying different formats and parsing strategies.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the ISO 8601 string representation of the date/time.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the DateTimeResult as an ISO 8601 date string for JSON encoding.
